children: United States 12 Month Oil Fund reported that its ultimate parent, Marygold Companies, entered a definitive agreement for an all-cash take-private transaction with Madison Dearborn Partners. The deal is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals, after which Marygold’s stock will be delisted from the New York Stock Exchange. Post-close, Marygold and Madison Dearborn plan to advance Marygold’s transformation strategy and refocus USCF’s business. There is no assurance the transaction will be completed on the expected timeline or at all.
